items.diagnosis: A chart-and-contraction schematic is a useful editorial aid because the example relates two affine blowup charts and their gluing to the exceptional P^1 and the map back to S. The absence of a diagram is not a mathematical defect.

diagram_details.kind: Point blowup with exceptional curve, affine chart overlap, and contraction
objects: S, a regular surface over k
p ∈ S, a k-rational closed point
maps_and_relations: π: S' → S is the blowup morphism and contracts E to p
π restricts to an isomorphism S'\E → S\{p}
Over Spec A with point ideal (x,y), cover the blowup by U_x = Spec A[y/x] and U_y = Spec A[x/y]
On U_x use T = y/x; on U_y use U = x/y; glue on T ≠ 0 and U ≠ 0 by U = T^{-1}
On the exceptional fiber, the chart pieces are affine lines with coordinates T and U, glued by U = T^{-1} to P^1_k
Label O_E(E) ≅ O_{P^1}(-1); mark E·E = -1 only under the additional hypothesis that S is projective over k
diagram_details.source_conventions: The source's chart notation A[y/x] and A[x/y] means the two standard blowup charts (equivalently A[t]/(xt−y) and A[u]/(yu−x)); T=y/x and U=x/y are inverse coordinates on the overlap. The maps point from S' to S, with E mapping to p.

mathematical_checks.domains_codomain: π has domain S' and codomain S; E is a closed Cartier divisor/subscheme of S' and maps to p. The restricted isomorphism is S'\E → S\{p}.
mathematical_checks.chart_gluing: The overlap is the locus where T is invertible in the first chart and U is invertible in the second; the transition is U=T^{-1}. Reversing that transition is equivalent only if chart coordinates are relabeled consistently.
mathematical_checks.exceptional_curve: The k-rationality of p gives E≅P^1_k; the two exceptional chart pieces glue by the same reciprocal transition.
mathematical_checks.normal_bundle_and_intersection: O_E(E)≅O_{P^1_k}(-1) is unconditional under the stated setup. E·E=-1 is stated only when S is projective over k; keep that qualifier attached to the label.
mathematical_checks.composition_and_signs: No composed square or sign convention is involved. If a diagram annotates divisor intersection, the value is −1, not +1.
mathematical_checks.status: No independent mathematical inconsistency was found; the diagram remains an optional aid and must not be treated as proof.
